content.comment_body: Hello, does anyone know how to resolve this issue? There are two control commands and four contacts. Input I1 together with a clock signal activates output Q2. Input I2 activates output Q3. If either I3 or I4 are turned on, both Q2 and Q3 are deactivated, regardless of the states of I1 or I2. When I1 and I4 return to the off state, I2 and the clock activate Q2 again, and I3 activates Q3.
